regressionReview.issue: Cooperating clients ignored persisted Retry-After when adopting pending work or when another client advanced the same request deadline.
regressionReview.fix: Adopt stored retry deadlines on refresh and spin discovery; reload the latest deadline under the recovery lock before replay.
